entities.summary: Hermodorus of Salamis was an ancient Greek architect from Salamis, Cyprus who was highly active in ancient Rome between 146 BC and 102 BC, where his work includes the Temple of Jupiter Stator and the Temple of Mars. He also inspired Vitruvius and led the construction of the Navalia.
